The '''Xextoan Infiloop''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] course on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]]. The course contained a set of six loops that met at a twelve-way intersection, causing it to host enormous crashes.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
